Name: mayo trail
Author: DriftedOasis
Description:
I got up at 6:00 am after accidentally staying up last night to make this. I am running off of sleep deprived courage. My brain is in shambles. This is a world-exploding mod. It's aedenthorn's rainbow trail, but Mayo flavored!11!!!! Who would of thought of that!!11!

I did


It honours me that my first mod is contributing to such a noble cause. The mayo trail itself took half an hour. The getting the code to work (despite it literally just being a retexture) took another half hour. The thumbnail took a full hour for some reason. I am very proud of this not at all wonky and very sad and blurry child.

I really hope no one else was making this but better
